verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs say the platform keeps the schedule, retries, and transformations for data ingestion, configured in the dashboard without deploying code, so scheduled data syncs run in the background. The Crawler and CI-friendly CLI scripting support this kind of pipeline automation. There is no evidence of general-purpose or AI-driven automations: Agent Studio is described only as conversational assistants. Missing for 10: general background automation or triggers beyond data ingestion, agent-driven autonomous tasks, detailed docs on scheduling options and monitoring, independent hands-on corroboration.
